verdict.rationale: First-party docs show natural-language creation ('Describe what you want in chat, and Activepieces builds the agent or automation for you') and editing ('describe a change in the editor... and the instructions and tools are rewritten for you'), plus a concrete changelog example turning a prompt into a drafted agent. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of this specific NL-to-workflow generation feature, and detail on how well it handles complex multi-step flow edits.
